paper.title_en: Effects of charm-strange resonances on charmed meson production by recombination in relativistic heavy ion collisions
paper.abstract_en: We discuss charmed mesons in heavy-ion collisions by focusing on their production from the quark-gluon plasma by quark recombination. We consider the production of not only the $D$, $D^*$, $D_s$, and $D_s^*$, but also the $D_{s0}^*(2317)$, $D_{s1}(2460)$, $D_{s1}(2536)$, and $D_{s2}^*(2573)$, thereby investigating the important role of heavier charm-strange resonances in understanding the measurements of the $D$ and $D_s$ mesons at the Large Hadron Collider at $\sqrt{s_{NN}}=5.02$ TeV. We calculate their yields and transverse momentum distributions, and also evaluate ratios of the transverse momentum distribution between various charmed mesons, i.e., the $D_s$ and $D^0$, the $D_s$ and $D^+$, $D_s^*$ and $D^{*0}$, and $D_s^*$ and $D^{*+}$. Through this analysis, we attempt to understand in more detail the effects of strangeness enhancement on charmed meson production in heavy-ion collisions at $\sqrt{s_{NN}}=5.02$ TeV.
